sampling.rule: SHA256(seed:segment_uid), six per [18,28), [28,60), [60,infinity) native-pixel-length bin per development tile; no model scores used

protocol.outer: leave one of three development sheets out
protocol.thresholds: inner two-sheet validation only; 0.95 first policy, 1.0 conservative policy added after inspecting the first results

region_spotchecks.scope: 12 small AI-selected regions, dark ink <=176, 2-pixel output proximity, not contour precision/recall

artifacts.illustration_scope: posthoc explanation only, not evaluation selection

limitations: Only three development sheets; excluded Gongju has not been viewed or tuned.
AI labels are imperfect, not human approvals or complete contour ground truth.
This compares classification of existing candidates, not missing contour detection or gap-joining correctness.
Outer-fold metrics use inner-only thresholds. All-data final model is not independently tested.
Equal length-bin sampling is not a population-weighted whole-map estimate.
The conservative policy was an exploratory follow-up; the same development outer folds were reused.
Missing contours before candidate generation and existing false joins are not completely evaluated.
No production default replacement or automatic plugin installation. The experiment originally remained local; code/evidence were subsequently prepared for commit and push at the user request.
